name: Soya Seekh Kebab
category: Healthy Indian Snacks and Street Food
ingredients: 50 g dry soy granules, soaked in hot water for 15 minutes and squeezed dry
1 small onion, finely grated and squeezed
1 tsp ginger-garlic paste and 1 green chilli, minced
1 tsp each coriander powder and garam masala
½ tsp red chilli powder and 1 tsp kasuri methi
steps: Mix all the ingredients except the oil to a firm, sticky mixture. Rest for 15 minutes.
Wet your hands and mould the mixture around skewers or into long fingers, making 8.
Cook on a hot grill pan for 8 minutes, turning, or bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.
Serve with onion rings, lemon and mint chutney.
note: Over 20 g protein per serving; soy granules give a convincing, kebab-like texture.
